[finding.crp.A]
head: Your inflammation marker sits in the middle zone, where most adults are.
today: Nothing you would feel.
why: This marker rises with anything that keeps the body on alert: short sleep, extra weight around the middle, gum trouble, a recent cold. In the middle zone it is something to keep low, not something to worry about.
do: Sleep, movement and less processed food usually bring it down.
summary: Background inflammation, in the middle zone.
closing: 
page 1 step: Calming the <a href="#heart">background inflammation</a> through sleep, movement and less processed food.

[finding.crp.B]
head: Your background inflammation appears to be clearly raised.
today: Nothing you would feel.
why: A raised reading can come from a passing infection, a hard workout or a poor week before the test, so one reading is not a verdict. If it stays raised, it adds to the wear on your arteries.
do: Consider reading it again in a few weeks, when you are well and rested. If it is still raised, it needs a deeper look for where it is coming from.
summary: Background inflammation, clearly raised.
closing: A result at this level is worth mentioning at your next routine check-up.
page 1 step: Calming the <a href="#heart">background inflammation</a> through sleep, movement and less processed food.

[finding.crp.C]
head: Your inflammation marker appears to be very high, which usually means your body was fighting something on the day of the test.
today: You may have felt unwell around the day of the test.
why: A reading this high is most often an infection or an injury. It also makes the body age in this report read older than it really is.
do: Consider repeating the test once you are well, and read your body age from that one.
summary: Inflammation, very high on the day of the test.
closing: A result this far outside its range needs a doctor's attention. Please speak to your doctor.
page 1 step: Calming the <a href="#heart">background inflammation</a> through sleep, movement and less processed food.

[finding.egfr_low.C]
head: Your kidney filtering figure appears to be below 60, the line at which it is usually checked again.
today: Nothing you would feel.
why: This figure is worked out from your creatinine, your age and your sex. It estimates how much blood your kidneys clean each minute, and it falls slowly with age. One reading below 60 cannot say whether it will hold: too little water, a hard workout or a high-protein meal before the test can sometimes lower it.
do: A repeat test, with a urine test alongside it, is the usual first step.
summary: Kidney filtering figure, below 60.
closing: A result this far outside its range needs a doctor's attention. Please speak to your doctor.
page 1 step: 

[finding.hb_high.A]
head: Your red cells sit just above their range.
today: Nothing you would feel.
why: Haemoglobin and haematocrit both measure how much of your blood is red cells. A reading a little above the range often means the blood was concentrated: too little water before the test is the commonest reason.
do: Come to your next test well hydrated, unless you have been told to limit fluids. It is read again then.
summary: Red cells, just above their range. Read again at your next test.
closing: 
page 1 step: 

[finding.hb_high.B]
head: Your red cells appear to be clearly above their range.
today: Nothing you would feel.
why: Haemoglobin and haematocrit both measure how much of your blood is red cells. A high reading can sometimes mean the blood was concentrated on the morning of the test. Smoking, living at altitude and sleep broken by pauses in breathing can raise it too. A repeat helps tell these apart.
do: Consider a repeat test, well hydrated, to see whether it holds.
summary: Red cells, just above their range. Read again at your next test.
closing: A result at this level is worth mentioning at your next routine check-up.
page 1 step: 

[finding.hb_high.C]
head: Your red cells appear to be far above their range.
today: Often nothing. Some people notice headaches, a flushed face or itching after a warm bath.
why: Haemoglobin and haematocrit both measure how much of your blood is red cells. At this level the blood may be thicker than it should be. Smoking, living at altitude and sleep broken by pauses in breathing can do it, and sometimes the body is making too many red cells. It is worth finding the reason.
do: A repeat test in the coming days is the usual first step, with a look at the reason.
summary: Red cells, just above their range. Read again at your next test.
closing: A result this far outside its range needs a doctor's attention. Please speak to your doctor.
page 1 step: 

[finding.hcy.A]
head: Your homocysteine sits just above its range.
today: Nothing you would feel.
why: Homocysteine is a by-product the body clears with the help of B vitamins. High levels go with artery disease, though bringing the number down has not been shown to prevent it. The useful question is why it is raised.
do: Leafy greens, pulses and eggs supply the vitamins that clear it. It is read again at your next test.
summary: Homocysteine, just above its range. Read again at your next test.
closing: 
page 1 step: 

[finding.hcy.B]
head: Your homocysteine appears to be clearly above its range.
today: Nothing you would feel.
why: Homocysteine is a by-product the body clears with the help of B vitamins. High levels go with artery disease, though bringing the number down has not been shown to prevent it. The useful question is why it is raised.
do: This needs a deeper look: why it is building up. That takes your history and a few further tests.
summary: Homocysteine, just above its range. Read again at your next test.
closing: A result at this level is worth mentioning at your next routine check-up.
page 1 step: 

[finding.hcy.C]
head: Your homocysteine appears to be far above its range.

why: Homocysteine is a by-product the body clears with the help of B vitamins. High levels go with artery disease, though bringing the number down has not been shown to prevent it. The useful question is why it is raised.

summary: Homocysteine, just above its range. Read again at your next test.
closing: A result this far outside its range needs a doctor's attention. Please speak to your doctor.

[finding.hdl_low.A]
head: Your protective cholesterol is on the low side.
today: Nothing you would feel.
why: Low protective cholesterol usually travels with raised triglycerides, weight around the middle and too little movement. It is a sign of those, more than a target of its own.
do: Regular movement, and the changes that bring triglycerides down.
summary: Protective cholesterol, on the low side.
closing: 
page 1 step: More regular movement, which is what a low <a href="#heart">protective cholesterol</a> points to.

[finding.hdl_low.B]

today: Nothing you would feel.
why: Low protective cholesterol usually travels with raised triglycerides, weight around the middle and too little movement. It is a sign of those, more than a target of its own.
do: Regular movement, and the changes that bring triglycerides down.

page 1 step: More regular movement, which is what a low <a href="#heart">protective cholesterol</a> points to.

[finding.lipids.A]
head: Your arteries are carrying a slightly heavier load of cholesterol particles than we would like.
today: You feel nothing. That is the difficulty with this one.
why: A heavier particle load is one of the patterns linked with heart disease later in life. At this level it is early, and it is one of the most changeable numbers in your report.
do: Food comes first: the kind of fat, the amount of fibre, what dinner looks like.
summary: The load of cholesterol particles your arteries carry, a little above the aim.
closing: 
page 1 step: Bringing the <a href="#heart">artery load</a> down through how you eat: which fats, how much fibre, what dinner looks like, what you reach for between meals.

[finding.lipids.C]
head: Your arteries are carrying a heavier load of cholesterol particles than is good for them.
today: You feel nothing. That is the difficulty with this one.
why: A heavy particle load is one of the patterns linked with heart disease later in life. It is also one of the most changeable.
do: Food comes first, and that is where the work starts.
summary: The load of cholesterol particles your arteries carry.
closing: Numbers at this level need a doctor's attention, because medicine can be part of the answer. Please speak to your doctor.
page 1 step: Bringing the <a href="#heart">artery load</a> down through how you eat: which fats, how much fibre, what dinner looks like, what you reach for between meals.

[finding.lpa.A]
head: One inherited part of your heart picture sits just above the line.
today: Nothing you would feel.
why: Lp(a) is a cholesterol particle set almost entirely by your genes. Food and exercise barely move it. Just above the line, it matters mainly as a reason to keep the rest of this section in good shape.
do: Nothing to do about the number itself. It rarely needs testing again.
summary: Lp(a), an inherited particle, just above the line. Nothing to do.
closing: 
page 1 step: 

[finding.lpa.B]
head: One inherited part of your heart picture appears to be clearly raised.
today: Nothing you would feel.
why: Lp(a) is a cholesterol particle set almost entirely by your genes. Food and exercise barely move it. A raised level adds to whatever the other numbers carry, so the other numbers matter more for you than for most people.
do: Keep the rest of this section as good as it can be. It runs in families, so it is worth telling yours.
summary: Lp(a), an inherited particle, just above the line. Nothing to do.
closing: A result at this level is worth mentioning at your next routine check-up.
page 1 step: 

[finding.lpa.C]
head: One inherited part of your heart picture appears to be far above the line.
today: Nothing you would feel.
why: Lp(a) is a cholesterol particle set almost entirely by your genes. Food and exercise barely move it. At this level it can be a risk of its own, whatever the other numbers say.
do: Keep the rest of this section as good as it can be. It runs in families, so it is worth telling yours.
summary: Lp(a), an inherited particle, just above the line. Nothing to do.
closing: A level this high needs a doctor's attention, because there are things a doctor can do about the overall risk. Please speak to your doctor.
page 1 step: 

[finding.phosphorus_low.A]
head: Your phosphorus sits just below its range.
today: Nothing you would feel.
why: Phosphorus works with calcium and vitamin D in bone and muscle. A reading a little below the range, with calcium in range, usually means little.
do: It is read again at your next test, alongside your vitamin D.
summary: Phosphorus, just below its range. Read again at your next test.
closing: 
page 1 step: 

[finding.phosphorus_low.B]
head: Your phosphorus appears to be clearly low.
today: Nothing you would feel.
why: Phosphorus works with calcium and vitamin D in bone and muscle. A low reading can sometimes follow low vitamin D, some medicines or eating very little. A repeat shows whether it holds.
do: Consider a repeat test, alongside your calcium and vitamin D.
summary: Phosphorus, just below its range. Read again at your next test.
closing: A result at this level is worth mentioning at your next routine check-up.
page 1 step: 

[finding.phosphorus_low.C]
head: Your phosphorus appears to be far below its range.
today: Often nothing. Marked muscle weakness would be a reason not to wait.
why: Phosphorus works with calcium and vitamin D in bone and muscle. A reading this low usually has a reason, and it is worth finding.
do: A repeat test in the coming days is the usual first step.
summary: Phosphorus, just below its range. Read again at your next test.
closing: A result this far outside its range needs a doctor's attention. Please speak to your doctor.
page 1 step: 

[finding.platelets_high.A]
head: Your platelet count sits just above its range.
today: Nothing you would feel.
why: Platelets are the cells that help blood clot. A count a little above the range often follows an infection, low iron or inflammation somewhere in the body. A repeat shows whether it was passing.
do: It is read again at your next test.
summary: Platelets, just above their range. Read again at your next test.
closing: 
page 1 step: 

[finding.platelets_high.B]
head: Your platelet count appears to be clearly above its range.
today: Nothing you would feel.
why: Platelets are the cells that help blood clot. A raised count often follows an infection, low iron or inflammation somewhere in the body. A repeat shows whether it holds.
do: Consider a repeat test, alongside your iron.
summary: Platelets, just above their range. Read again at your next test.
closing: A result at this level is worth mentioning at your next routine check-up.
page 1 step: 

[finding.platelets_high.C]
head: Your platelet count appears to be far above its range.
today: Nothing you would feel.
why: Platelets are the cells that help blood clot. A count this high can sometimes follow an infection, low iron or inflammation, and occasionally the body is making too many. It is worth finding the reason.
do: A repeat test in the coming days is the usual first step, with a look at the reason.
summary: Platelets, just above their range. Read again at your next test.
closing: A result this far outside its range needs a doctor's attention. Please speak to your doctor.
page 1 step: 

[finding.tg.A]
head: The fat travelling in your blood sits just above the line.
today: Nothing you would feel.
why: Triglycerides rise with sugar, refined carbohydrate and alcohol more than with fat, and they fall quickly when those change. Raised for years, they add to the load on your arteries.
do: Less sugar, refined carbohydrate and alcohol, and a walk after meals. This number often moves within weeks.
summary: Triglycerides, the fat travelling in your blood, just above the line.
closing: 
page 1 step: Bringing your <a href="#heart">triglycerides</a> down: less sugar, refined carbohydrate and alcohol, and a walk after meals.

[finding.tg.C]
head: The fat travelling in your blood appears to be very high.
today: Often nothing. Severe pain in the upper belly would be a reason not to wait.
why: At this level triglycerides can become a risk of their own, because they can sometimes inflame the pancreas.
do: Less sugar, refined carbohydrate and alcohol, and a walk after meals. This number often moves within weeks.
summary: Triglycerides, the fat travelling in your blood, very high.
closing: A result this far outside its range needs a doctor's attention. Please speak to your doctor.
